title: DOJ corrects Leviste: Alleged violation of the law not a small matter
summary: Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida stressed on Thursday that the case against Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste is far from the "small matter" that the first-term congressman says it is.
